text:
sarah: Postmortem follow-up: root cause summary - expired service token reused by a canary pod + a short-lived log-forwarder hiccup that dropped token_validation rows. We need explicit owners, short mitigations, and a preventative cadence.
ben: I can own audit detection + dashboarding. Will add a panel that surfaces minute-level gaps and correlate with forwarder restarts. ETA: Thu EOD.
ivy: I will own secrets rotation verification and the runbook updates. Plan: canary rotation in prod tonight with on-call. Need the exact secret names and affected service list.
pager-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-2044. Pager duty runbook linked.
sarah: Short mitigations: 1) temporarily reject tokens older than 5m that have no matching validation log, 2) enable a hotfix emitter-retry for the forwarder, 3) schedule an immediate rotation of the affected service account. Assign owners below.
ben: Query I'll use to detect gaps: ```sql
SELECT service, date_trunc('minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) AS rows
FROM audit_logs
WHERE event='token_validation' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY service, minute
ORDER BY minute DESC;
```
ben: Also plan a Grafana alert: expr = sum(rate(audit_log_miss_total[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(audit_log_total[5m])) by (service) > 0.001 -> page. Will open PR infra-alerts.
ivy: Rotation checklist (compact): 1) create new key alias in KMS, 2) update k8s secret (kubectl apply), 3) annotate deployment for graceful drain, 4) rolling restart, 5) smoke validate, 6) collect evidence bundle. Smoke command: ```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://auth.redwood.example/v1/validate | jq .status
```
sarah: Owners & deadlines: ben - audit dashboard/alert (due: 2026-04-15), ivy - rotate+evidence+runbook (due: 2026-04-14), sarah - postmortem doc + trends (due: 2026-04-17). @sec-team-bot please create tasks with these owners and deadlines.
sec-team-bot: Tasks created: SEC-2044-A audit-dashboard (owner:ben, due:2026-04-15), SEC-2044-B rotation-verify (owner:ivy, due:2026-04-14), SEC-2044-C postmortem-trends (owner:sarah, due:2026-04-17). Evidence upload required on completion.
ben: Initial query results posted to the tracker: 9 missing token_validation rows for service=ingress-proxy during the window 2026-04-02T22:10:00Z - 2026-04-02T22:16:00Z. Sample log snippet: ```[2026-04-02T22:12:04Z] ingress-proxy token=*** validation=NULL emitter=forwarder-3 restart=true ctx=rid=zz9``` Looks like forwarder restarted mid-burst.
ivy: Staging rotation completed; smoke passed. Scheduling prod canary at 23:00 UTC with on-call. Will annotate the deployment with `redwood.com/drain=true` and upload the runbook link: http://runbooks/internal/auth-rotation.
sarah: Let's also add a weekly smoke job that runs token validation checks across all critical services post-deploy and on Mondays. Make failures create low-severity tickets and escalate if >3 failures in 24h.
ben: I'll implement the weekly smoke metric `postdeploy_token_smoke_failures_total` and add a dashboard panel. PR will include correlation panel between emitter restarts and missing rows.
ivy: After prod canary I'll bundle evidence: smoke output, k8s rollout history, and forwarder logs, then attach to SEC-2044-B.
sec-team-bot: Reminder: include compliance evidence (signed manifest + logs) when closing SEC-2044-B.
sarah: Also tracking recurrence: ben, please pull incident frequency for the last 180 days and add a small chart to the postmortem doc. We think this pattern (rotation timing + emitter blips) occurred 4x in that window.
ben: Will add counts and a timeline. If pattern confirmed, propose a hardening story to make forwarder durable across restarts.
ivy: If rotation shows any drift, I'll coordinate an emergency rollback plan and notify on-call immediately.
sarah: OK reconvene Friday 10:30 to review evidence and close tasks, or earlier if blockers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
